dedupe_keys.name: list of major coal mine overburden dump failures in india 1995 2019

description: A short list describing the nature and causes of overburden (waste rock) dump failures observed in Indian coal mines from 1995 to 2019. The Mendeley Data record by R. M. Bishwal holds one Excel file (WDRs Failure in India) of about 11 KB; version 2, published on 27 July 2019, extends an earlier version 1 that ended in 2017. It is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Indian coal mines. Beyond the one-line summary, the page read does not state how many failures are listed, which fields are given or which sources were used, so those details are not stated on the page read. Caveats: it is a small, single-author compilation with no documented method or update plan. For simulation it gives a list of historical slope failures at mine dumps, to use as event examples or a rough base rate when modelling slope stability hazards in open-cast mines. Related catalogue records include the global databases of tailings dam failures and the WISE chronology of tailings dam failures, which cover tailings, not overburden dumps.
